plugins.description: Claude Code skills from Annetaan Inc. Holds workflow, which runs one implementation as design, approval, per-task implement and review rounds, an integration review, and a finish step that can open a pull request. Also doc-meta, doc-review and doc-revise, which let you flag sentences in a document with an opinion and have the document revised to match.
